info.title: SportyBet API
info.description:
A live, auto-generated OpenAPI for SportyBet (sportybet.com).

The paths mirror SportyBet's own frontend API (`/api/ng` on https://www.sportybet.com), so this document is a proxy surface: call these paths on this server and it forwards them to SportyBet with the stored session, then returns the site's JSON unchanged.

Schemas are inferred from live responses at generation time, so they follow the site. Regenerate with `npm run generate` to pick up new fields.

A signed-in session is loaded: Account endpoints will return data.
